caseNameFull: Hannah L. Andrews, etc. v. Harvey K. Partridge, Trustee, etc.
attorneys: Mr. Thomas E. French and Mr. Samuel H. Richards for the petitioner. Mr. Henry F. Stockwell and Mr. John D. McMullih for the respondent.

opinions.text: Petition for a writ of certiorari to the United States Circuit Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit granted, and ordered that transcript on file herein stand as the return to the writ of certiorari.
